svg.aria-label: ML Path — Learning platform · flagship · in development
svg.title: ML Path
svg.text: An interactive course that takes a first-year student to an ML
internship: a phased roadmap, lessons with quizzes, real
Python right in the browser (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn on
Pyodide), first-year university math and an algorithms track
where every step is animated next to the code in Python and
algo-viz · insertion sort · step by step
